raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly conflated Århus/Aarhus with Ålborg/Aalborg, claiming the spellings “Århus/Aarhus” correspond to Aalborg and concluding the birthplace as Aalborg. Aarhus and Aalborg are distinct Danish cities; the sources clearly stated Århus/Aarhus (Aarhus), Denmark as Anne Gadegaard’s birthplace.
